command_path_recording: Actual argv with executable basename and labeled temporary paths; no commands were inferred from trace content.

display.text_encoding: JSON scalar notation; non-ASCII/control characters escaped, not replaced by missing glyphs

encoder.path_recording: Actual supplied executable basename; private installation path omitted.
encoder.version: ffmpeg version n7.0.1-playwright-build-1011 Copyright (c) 2000-2024 the FFmpeg developers

fidelity.comparison: Mean absolute 8-bit RGB error against each original Pillow frame, including MJPEG and VP8 losses
fidelity.order_validation: Every decoded frame's visible progress cursor matches its expected source position within 2 pixels
fidelity.ordered_digest_algorithm: SHA-256 of concatenated binary SHA-256 RGB frame digests in one-based frame order

limitations: Caller-supplied evidence is local provenance, not proof of independent goldens, native creation, installation, or execution.
The caller must rerun and validate DEMO against its independent golden before invoking this renderer.
Trace table snapshots with synthetic progress/active-row motion, not a screen recording, live interaction, or actual execution timing.
Silent video: no narration or audio-understanding claim.
Shortened text is explicitly marked; full supplied values remain in the trace, and the full title is in this report.
Rows absent from the source trace cannot be reconstructed; declared subsets are labeled separately from display pagination.

provenance_details.canonical_trace_serialization: UTF-8, sorted keys, compact separators, ensure_ascii=false, LF terminator
provenance_details.checks: Exact evidence fields, SHA-256 shapes, DEMO ID, matching trace scenario and input hash

reproducibility.scope: Video bytes require identical trace, title, renderer, Python/Pillow/fonts, encoder bytes and options on the same platform. Recorded argv uses explicit portable path tokens, not private machine paths.

runtime_dependency: none; this optional developer producer and its dependencies are not shipped in plugins
synthetic_label_every_frame: Synthetic baseline execution visualization - not Cowork or a live system

timeline.caption: Inventoried the supplied synthetic attachment; no external files or services were read.
Validated exact schemas, primary IDs, decimal strings, and row-local temporal constraints.
Joined every line without deduplication; structural billing holds are retained separately from evidence pricing.
Excluded future POD independently, then resolved unique eligible revisions and half-open UTC-date rate matches.
Rounded each fuel charge half-up and priced exact-second ceiling blocks; caps limit detention money, never block counts.
Compared only priceable, structurally supported billings with the symmetric inclusive tolerance; other variances stay null.
Assigned synthetic review owners and strict missing-POD grace decisions; no carrier contact or business action occurs.
Re-evaluated every prior case without editing history; unresolved evidence cannot establish that a variance has cleared.
Emitted every entity and owned issue; currency totals preserve ready/held amounts and compare only paired computed charges.
